title: The truncation hypercohomology spectral sequence
statement:
Let $v:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ be a left exact additive functor [def-sp-left-exact-additive] between Grothendieck abelian categories [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian], with right derived functor $Rv:D^+(\mathcal A)\to D^+(\mathcal B)$ computed by K-injective resolutions [def-sp-kinjective-bridge], and $R^pv$ ($p\geq0$) its derived functors on objects [def-sp-left-exact-additive]. Let $K\in\operatorname{Ch}^+(\mathcal A)$ be a bounded below complex and $a\in\mathbf Z$ with $\mathcal H^q(K)=0$ for $q<a$; let $\tau_{\leq q}K$ be its canonical truncations [def-sbc-standard-tstructure-derived-category]. Let $(D,E,\alpha,f,g)$ be the truncation couple of $K$ [def-sp-truncation-couple], $D^{p,q}=\mathcal H^{p+q}(Rv\,\tau_{\leq q}K)$, $E^{p,q}=\mathcal H^{p+q}(Rv(\mathcal H^q(K)[-q]))$, $\alpha=\mathcal H^{p+q}(Rv\,i_{q+1}):D^{p,q}\to D^{p-1,q+1}$ induced by the inclusion $i_{q+1}:\tau_{\leq q}K\to\tau_{\leq q+1}K$, and let $(E_r,d_r)_{r\geq2}$, $E_2=E$, $d_r$ of bidegree $(r,1-r)$, be its spectral sequence [def-sp-exact-couple], with iterated couples $C_r=(D_r,E_r,\alpha_r,f_r,g_r)$ and subobjects $Z_r^{p,q},B_r^{p,q}\subseteq E_2^{p,q}$ as in [def-sp-convergence]. For $n\in\mathbf Z$ put $H^n=\mathcal H^n(RvK)$, let $c_n:A^n:=D^{0,n}=\mathcal H^n(Rv\,\tau_{\leq n}K)\to H^n$ be induced by the inclusion $\tau_{\leq n}K\to K$, and give $H^n$ the decreasing filtration [def-sp-filtration]
$$F^pH^n=\operatorname{im}\bigl(\mathcal H^n(Rv\,\tau_{\leq n-p}K)\to\mathcal H^n(RvK)\bigr)\qquad(p\in\mathbf Z),$$
the map induced by the inclusion $\tau_{\leq n-p}K\to K$. Then:

1. **(Exact couple.)** $(D,E,\alpha,f,g)$ is an exact couple, and so is every $C_r$.
2. **($E_2$-page.)** For $p\geq0$ and all $q$ there is an isomorphism, natural in $K$, $E_2^{p,q}=\mathcal H^{p+q}(Rv(\mathcal H^qK[-q]))\cong\mathcal H^p(Rv(\mathcal H^qK[0]))\cong R^pv(\mathcal H^q(K))$, namely the composite of part 2 of [lem-sp-shift-identification]; and $E_2^{p,q}=0$ for $p<0$.
3. **(Quadrant, finitely many terms.)** $D^{p,q}=0$ for $q<a$; $E_r^{p,q}=0$ for every $r\geq2$ unless $p\geq0$ and $q\geq a$; in total degree $n$ only $a\leq q\leq n$ (equivalently $0\leq p\leq n-a$) can carry a nonzero term.
4. **(Stabilization; regularity.)** The differentials $d_r$ out of and into $E_r^{p,q}$ vanish for $r>\max(q-a+1,p)$, so $Z_r^{p,q}$ and $B_r^{p,q}$ are constant for $r\geq r_0(p,q):=\max(2,q-a+2,p+1)$, $E_\infty^{p,q}=Z_\infty^{p,q}/B_\infty^{p,q}$ exists and equals $E_{r_0}^{p,q}$. In particular the couple is regular in the sense of [def-sp-convergence] and Stacks 0BDU (1) (the $Z_r$ eventually constant), and also coregular in the sense of Stacks 0BDU (2) (the $B_r$ eventually constant).
5. **(Completeness, finite filtration.)** $\operatorname{im}(\alpha^r:D^{p+r,q-r}\to D^{p,q})=0$ for $r>q-a$, so the couple is complete [def-sp-convergence]. The map $c_n$ is an isomorphism, and $F^pH^n$ is the image filtration [def-sp-image-filtration] along $c_n$ of the filtration $F^pA^n:=\operatorname{im}(\alpha^p:D^{p,n-p}\to A^n)$ ($p\geq0$), $F^pA^n:=A^n$ ($p\leq0$), i.e. $F^pH^n=c_n(F^pA^n)$. It satisfies $F^pH^n=H^n$ for $p\leq0$ and $F^pH^n=0$ for $p\geq n-a+1$: it is finite, exhaustive and separated, and $H^n=\lim_pH^n/F^pH^n$.
6. **(Abutment.)** For $p,q$ with $n=p+q$ and $p\geq0$, fix $r=r_1(p,q):=\max(p+3,q-a+2)$, $u=p-r+2$, $v=q+r-2$, and $\lambda_u=\alpha^{-u}:A^n=D^{0,n}\to D^{u,v}$ (an isomorphism). Then $g_r:D_r^{u,v}\to E_r^{p,q}$ induces an isomorphism $\psi^{p,q}:\operatorname{gr}^pA^n=F^pA^n/F^{p+1}A^n\xrightarrow{\lambda_u}D_r^{u,v}/\alpha_r(D_r^{u+1,v-1})\xrightarrow{\bar g_r}E_r^{p,q}=E_\infty^{p,q}$, and
$$\Theta^{p,q}:=\psi^{p,q}\circ\operatorname{gr}^p(c_n)^{-1}:\ \operatorname{gr}^pH^{p+q}=F^pH^{p+q}/F^{p+1}H^{p+q}\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }E_\infty^{p,q}$$
is an isomorphism; for $p<0$ both sides are $0$. So the spectral sequence converges, with no limit condition, in the sense of [def-sp-convergence]:
$$E_2^{p,q}=R^pv(\mathcal H^q(K))\Longrightarrow\mathcal H^{p+q}(RvK).

proof.text: Use raw-map exactness for the specified HasDerivedCategory instances. Construct the type-zero BigradedExactCouple with raw D,E,alpha,f and indexed g. Each exactness field follows from ShortComplex.exact_iff_image_eq_kernel. Its three structure-map equations simplify to identities.

Construct the natural E2 comparison by whiskering the inverse single-functor shift isomorphism, RF commShiftIso, the homology shift isomorphism, and the ordinary derived functor comparison. The latter is a natural isomorphism obtained by whiskering rightDerivedFunctorPlusCompatibility and composing with singleFunctorCompRightDerivedFunctorPlusCompHomologyFunctorIso. Its component formula holds definitionally. The E-term comparison is the inverse bridge followed by its component at K.

Apply truncation_quadrant_vanishing for the two initial support conditions. Apply halfPlane_sharp_bounds to supply later-page support, boundedness, vanishing differentials, sharp cycle and boundary constancy, regularity, incoming-image vanishing, and completeness.

Apply truncation_canonical_abutment to this exact couple and its three structure-map equalities. This supplies the canonical inclusions and maps to H, finite transported image filtrations, the specified graded maps and equations, and the diagonal colimit giving convergence. Combine these witnesses with the preceding clauses by conjunction and existential introduction.

split_report.summary: Statement made precise: hypotheses on A, B, v (left exact additive, Grothendieck), K bounded below with H^q=0 for q<a; the E_2 isomorphism named (part 2 of lem-sp-shift-identification); the decreasing filtration F^pH^n=im(H^n(Rv tau_{<=n-p}K)->H^n(RvK)) as the image filtration along the isomorphism c_n of the canonical filtration im(alpha^p) of D^{0,n}; the isomorphism Theta: gr^p H^n -> E_infinity named explicitly (thm-sp-half-plane-convergence names none); regular stated in both senses, since def-sp-convergence's 'regular' (B_r eventually constant) is Stacks' 'coregular' (0BDU (2)); completeness. The one-paragraph imported proof replaced by 7 steps, following Steps 1, 3-6 of lemma-weil-pbc-hypercohomology-convergence for a general v and citing the same nodes. Imported proof errors: 'D-terms vanish for q<a because tau_{<=q}K=0' is false for a K with nonzero terms below a (tau_{<=q}K is only acyclic; fixed through lem-weil-pbc-truncation-cohomology and the negative-vanishing lemma); E^{p,q}=0 for p<0 was not argued. def-sp-injective-resolutions dropped (replaced by the closed lem-weil-pbc-derived-functor-negative-vanishing); added lem-sp-derived-couple-exact, lem-weil-pbc-truncation-cohomology, lem-weil-pbc-derived-direct-image-triangulated, lem-weil-pbc-derived-functor-truncation-iso, lem-weil-pbc-derived-functor-negative-vanishing. No new node. Mathlib: spectral objects, TStructure.spectralObject and Abelian.SpectralObject.spectralSequence exist, no convergence, no exact couples.

The map $c_n$ is an isomorphism, and $F^pH^n$ is the image filtration [def-sp-image-filtration] along $c_n$ of the filtration $F^pA^n:=\operatorname{im}(\alpha^p:D^{p,n-p}\to A^n)$ ($p\geq0$), $F^pA^n:=A^n$ ($p\leq0$), i.e. $F^pH^n=c_n(F^pA^n)$. It satisfies $F^pH^n=H^n$ for $p\leq0$ and $F^pH^n=0$ for $p\geq n-a+1$: it is finite, exhaustive and separated, and $H^n=\lim_pH^n/F^pH^n$.
6. **(Abutment.)** For $p,q$ with $n=p+q$ and $p\geq0$, fix $r=r_1(p,q):=\max(p+3,q-a+2)$, $u=p-r+2$, $v=q+r-2$, and $\lambda_u=\alpha^{-u}:A^n=D^{0,n}\to D^{u,v}$ (an isomorphism). Then $g_r:D_r^{u,v}\to E_r^{p,q}$ induces an isomorphism $\psi^{p,q}:\operatorname{gr}^pA^n=F^pA^n/F^{p+1}A^n\xrightarrow{\lambda_u}D_r^{u,v}/\alpha_r(D_r^{u+1,v-1})\xrightarrow{\bar g_r}E_r^{p,q}=E_\infty^{p,q}$, and
$$\Theta^{p,q}:=\psi^{p,q}\circ\operatorname{gr}^p(c_n)^{-1}:\ \operatorname{gr}^pH^{p+q}=F^pH^{p+q}/F^{p+1}H^{p+q}\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }E_\infty^{p,q}$$
is an isomorphism; for $p<0$ both sides are $0$. So the spectral sequence converges, with no limit condition, in the sense of [def-sp-convergence]:
$$E_2^{p,q}=R^pv(\mathcal H^q(K))\Longrightarrow\mathcal H^{p+q}(RvK).

Also def-sp-convergence now defines regularity by eventual constancy of cycles, so the old statement incorrectly attributes boundary constancy to that definition; both cycle and boundary constancy remain asserted. Add the already named and landed shift identification to stmt_deps.

old_proof.text: **Step 1 (exact couple and iterated couples; part 1).** By [lem-sp-truncation-couple-exact] the truncation couple $(D,E,\alpha,f,g)$ of $K$ [def-sp-truncation-couple] is an exact couple [def-sp-exact-couple], with $\alpha=\mathcal H^{p+q}(Rv\,i_{q+1})$, $g=\mathcal H^{p+q}(Rv\,j_q)$ and $f$ the boundary of $Rv$ of the truncation triangle (Step 1 there). By [lem-sp-derived-couple-exact] the iterated couples $C_r$, $C_2=(D,E,\alpha,f,g)$, $C_{r+1}=C_r'$, are exact couples for all $r\geq2$, with $D_r^{p,q}=\operatorname{im}(\alpha^{r-2}:D^{p+r-2,q-r+2}\to D^{p,q})$, $\alpha_r$ the restriction of $\alpha$, $f_r$ of bidegree $(2,-1)$, $g_r$ of bidegree $(r-2,2-r)$, and $E_{r+1}=\ker d_r/\operatorname{im}d_r$, $d_r=g_r\circ f_r$ of bidegree $(r,1-r)$; this is the spectral sequence of the couple of [def-sp-exact-couple].

old_proof.text: **Step 2 (the $E_2$-page; part 2).** $E_2^{p,q}=E^{p,q}=\mathcal H^{p+q}(Rv(\mathcal H^q(K)[-q]))$ by [def-sp-exact-couple] ($E_2=E$). For $p\geq0$, part 2 of [lem-sp-shift-identification] gives the isomorphism $\mathcal H^{p+q}(Rv(\mathcal H^qK[-q]))\cong\mathcal H^p(Rv(\mathcal H^qK[0]))\cong R^pv(\mathcal H^qK)$, natural in $K$ (the composite of $\mathcal H^{p+q}(\sigma^{-q})$, the shift identification $\tau^{-q,p+q}$ and $\theta^p$ named there); for $p<0$ part 3 of that lemma gives $E_2^{p,q}=0$. This is the $E_2$-term $R^pF(H^q(K^\bullet))$ of the second spectral sequence of Stacks 015J.

**Step 3 (quadrant and finitely many terms; part 3).** We use [lem-weil-pbc-derived-functor-negative-vanishing]: if $M\in D^+(\mathcal A)$ has $\mathcal H^i(M)=0$ for $i<b$, then $\mathcal H^j(RvM)=0$ for $j<b$. (i) $D^{p,q}=0$ for $q<a$: by [lem-weil-pbc-truncation-cohomology], $\mathcal H^i(\tau_{\leq q}K)\cong\mathcal H^i(K)=0$ for $i\leq q$ (as $i\leq q<a$) and $\mathcal H^i(\tau_{\leq q}K)=0$ for $i>q$, so $\tau_{\leq q}K$ is acyclic (it need not be the zero complex, since the terms $K^i$, $i<a$, need not vanish), and the lemma with $b=p+q+1$ gives $\mathcal H^{p+q}(Rv\,\tau_{\leq q}K)=0$. (ii) $E^{p,q}=0$ for $q<a$: $\mathcal H^q(K)=0$, so $\mathcal H^q(K)[-q]$ is the zero complex, and the lemma with $b=p+q+1$ applies. (iii) $E^{p,q}=0$ for $p<0$: $\mathcal H^q(K)[-q]$ is concentrated in degree $q$, the lemma with $b=q$ gives $\mathcal H^{p+q}=0$ for $p+q<q$ (Step 2). So $E_2^{p,q}=0$ unless $p\geq0$, $q\geq a$. For $r\geq2$, $E_{r+1}^{p,q}=\ker d_r/\operatorname{im}d_r$ is a subquotient of $E_r^{p,q}$ (Step 1), hence by induction of $E_2^{p,q}$, and so vanishes wherever $E_2^{p,q}$ does; likewise $E_\infty^{p,q}=Z_\infty^{p,q}/B_\infty^{p,q}$ [def-sp-convergence] when it exists. If $p+q=n$ and $E_r^{p,q}\neq0$ then $q\geq a$ and $p=n-q\geq0$: $a\leq q\leq n$, $0\leq p\leq n-a$, at most $n-a+1$ bidegrees, none if $n<a$ (bounded, Stacks 0BDU (3)). This repeats Steps 1 and 3 of [lemma-weil-pbc-hypercohomology-convergence] for a general $v$.

old_proof.text: **Step 4 (stabilization and regularity; part 4).** $d_r$ has bidegree $(r,1-r)$ (Step 1). Out of $(p,q)$ it lands in $E_r^{p+r,q-r+1}$, zero by Step 3 when $q-r+1<a$, i.e. $r>q-a+1$; into $(p,q)$ it starts at $E_r^{p-r,q+r-1}$, zero when $p-r<0$, i.e. $r>p$. For $r\geq r_0(p,q)=\max(q-a+2,p+1)$ both vanish, so $E_{r+1}^{p,q}=\ker d_r/\operatorname{im}d_r=E_r^{p,q}$; in terms of [def-sp-convergence], $Z_{r+1}^{p,q}$ (inverse image of $\ker d_r=E_r^{p,q}$) equals $Z_r^{p,q}$ and $B_{r+1}^{p,q}$ (inverse image of $\operatorname{im}d_r=0$) equals $B_r^{p,q}$. Hence $Z_\infty^{p,q}=\bigcap_rZ_r^{p,q}=Z_{r_0}^{p,q}$ and $B_\infty^{p,q}=\bigcup_rB_r^{p,q}=B_{r_0}^{p,q}$ exist and $E_\infty^{p,q}=E_{r_0}^{p,q}$. The $B_r$ being eventually constant is "regular" as [def-sp-convergence] words it, which is Stacks' "coregular" (0BDU (2), 0BDV (2)); the $Z_r$ being eventually constant is Stacks' "regular" (0BDU (1), 0BDV (1)); both hold, so the terminological difference does not matter here. This is the stabilization bound $r>\max(q-a+1,p)$ of [thm-sp-half-plane-convergence], whose hypotheses ($D^{p,q}=0$ for $q<a$, $E_2^{p,q}=0$ unless $p\geq0$, $q\geq a$) hold by Step 3.

old_proof.text: **Step 5 (the canonical abutment $A^n=D^{0,n}$, its filtration, completeness).** Put $A^n=D^{0,n}$ and $F^pA^n=\operatorname{im}(\alpha^p:D^{p,n-p}\to A^n)$ for $p\geq0$, $F^pA^n=A^n$ for $p\leq0$, a decreasing filtration [def-sp-filtration] ($\alpha^{p+1}=\alpha^p\circ\alpha$, so $F^{p+1}\subseteq F^p$); it is the filtration $F^pA^n=G_{n-p}A^n$ of [thm-sp-half-plane-convergence]. For $p\geq n-a+1$ the source $D^{p,n-p}$ has second index $n-p<a$, so it is $0$ (Step 3) and $F^pA^n=0$; with $F^0A^n=A^n$ the filtration is finite, exhaustive (union $F^0=A^n$) and separated (intersection inside $F^{n-a+1}=0$) (Stacks 0121). Completeness: $\operatorname{im}(\alpha^r:D^{p+r,q-r}\to D^{p,q})=0$ as soon as $q-r<a$, i.e. for $r>q-a$, so the intersection over $r$ is $0$ [def-sp-convergence]. Moreover, for $w\leq-1$ the map $\alpha:D^{w+1,n-w-1}\to D^{w,n-w}$ is an isomorphism: by the exactness of [def-sp-exact-couple] its kernel is $\operatorname{im}(f:E^{w-1,n-w}\to D^{w+1,n-w-1})=0$ and its image is $\ker(g:D^{w,n-w}\to E^{w,n-w})=D^{w,n-w}$, both $E$-terms having negative first index (Step 3). So $\lambda_w:=\alpha^{-w}:A^n\to D^{w,n-w}$ is an isomorphism for $w\leq0$, $\lambda_0=\mathrm{id}$.

old_proof.text: **Step 6 ($E_\infty\cong\operatorname{gr}A$: the isomorphism $\psi$).** Let $n=p+q$, $p\geq0$, $r=r_1(p,q)=\max(p+3,q-a+2)$, $u=p-r+2\leq-1$, $v=q+r-2$. By Step 1, $D_r^{u,v}=\operatorname{im}(\alpha^{r-2}:D^{p,q}\to D^{u,v})$, and $\alpha^{r-2}=\lambda_u\circ\alpha^p$ on $D^{p,q}$ (exponents $p+(-u)=r-2$), so $D_r^{u,v}=\lambda_u(F^pA^n)$; likewise ($u+1\leq0$) $D_r^{u+1,v-1}=\operatorname{im}(\alpha^{r-2}:D^{p+1,q-1}\to D^{u+1,v-1})=\lambda_{u+1}(F^{p+1}A^n)$, and $\alpha_r$, the restriction of $\alpha$, maps it onto $\alpha\lambda_{u+1}(F^{p+1}A^n)=\lambda_u(F^{p+1}A^n)$. The map $f_r:E_r^{p,q}\to D_r^{p+2,q-1}=\operatorname{im}(\alpha^{r-2}:D^{p+r,q-r+1}\to D^{p+2,q-1})$ is zero since $q-r+1<a$ gives $D^{p+r,q-r+1}=0$. Exactness of the exact couple $C_r$ (Step 1) at $D_r^{u,v}$ and at $E_r^{p,q}$ ($g_r$ has bidegree $(r-2,2-r)$, so $g_r:D_r^{u,v}\to E_r^{p,q}$) gives the exact sequence $D_r^{u+1,v-1}\xrightarrow{\alpha_r}D_r^{u,v}\xrightarrow{g_r}E_r^{p,q}\to0$. Hence $\bar g_r:D_r^{u,v}/\alpha_r(D_r^{u+1,v-1})\to E_r^{p,q}$ is an isomorphism, and composing with the isomorphism $F^pA^n/F^{p+1}A^n\cong\lambda_u(F^pA^n)/\lambda_u(F^{p+1}A^n)$ induced by the isomorphism $\lambda_u$ (Step 5) gives the isomorphism $\psi^{p,q}:\operatorname{gr}^pA^n\to E_r^{p,q}$; as $r\geq r_0(p,q)$, $E_r^{p,q}=E_\infty^{p,q}$ (Step 4). For $p<0$: $\operatorname{gr}^pA^n=A^n/A^n=0$ ($p+1\leq0$) and $E_\infty^{p,q}=0$ (Step 3). This is the isomorphism $\psi_r$ of part 3 of [lem-sp-exact-functor-couple] and the identification $E_r^{p,q}=G_qA^{p+q}/G_{q-1}A^{p+q}$ of [thm-sp-half-plane-convergence], whose statement does not name the map; the argument is written out here so that $\Theta$ below is a named map.

old_proof.text: **Step 7 (the abutment is $\mathcal H^n(RvK)$ with the stated filtration; parts 5 and 6).** By [lem-weil-pbc-derived-direct-image-triangulated] $Rv$ is a functor $D^+(\mathcal A)\to D^+(\mathcal B)$ and $\mathcal H^n$ is a functor, so $\alpha^p:D^{p,n-p}\to D^{0,n}$, the composite of the $\mathcal H^n(Rv\,i_{m+1})$ for $n-p\leq m<n$ (Step 1), is $\mathcal H^n(Rv)$ of the composite inclusion $\tau_{\leq n-p}K\to\tau_{\leq n}K$, and $c_n\circ\alpha^p$ is $\mathcal H^n(Rv)$ of the inclusion $\tau_{\leq n-p}K\to K$. By [lem-weil-pbc-derived-functor-truncation-iso], $c_n:\mathcal H^n(Rv\,\tau_{\leq n}K)\to\mathcal H^n(RvK)$ is an isomorphism. Hence for $p\geq0$, $c_n(F^pA^n)=\operatorname{im}(c_n\circ\alpha^p)=F^pH^n$, and for $p\leq0$, $c_n(F^pA^n)=c_n(A^n)=H^n$, which equals $F^pH^n$ because $\operatorname{im}(\mathcal H^n(Rv\,\tau_{\leq n-p}K)\to H^n)$ contains $\operatorname{im}(c_n)=H^n$ ($\tau_{\leq n}K\subseteq\tau_{\leq n-p}K$, functoriality again). So $F^pH^n$ is the image filtration [def-sp-image-filtration] of $(A^n,F)$ along $c_n$, and $c_n$ is an isomorphism of filtered objects $(A^n,F)\cong(H^n,F)$. Transporting Step 5: $F^pH^n=H^n$ for $p\leq0$, $F^pH^n=0$ for $p\geq n-a+1$, finite, exhaustive, separated, and the inverse system $H^n/F^pH^n$ is constant ($=H^n$) for $p\geq n-a+1$, so $H^n=\lim_pH^n/F^pH^n$ with no $\lim^1$ condition (Stacks 012U (3)). $c_n$ induces isomorphisms $\operatorname{gr}^p(c_n):\operatorname{gr}^pA^n\to\operatorname{gr}^pH^n$, so $\Theta^{p,q}=\psi^{p,q}\circ\operatorname{gr}^p(c_n)^{-1}$ is an isomorphism $\operatorname{gr}^pH^{p+q}\cong E_\infty^{p,q}$ (Step 6). With Step 4 (regular) and Step 5 (complete) this is convergence in the sense of [def-sp-convergence], and with Step 2 it is $E_2^{p,q}=R^pv(\mathcal H^qK)\Rightarrow\mathcal H^{p+q}(RvK)$, as in Stacks 015J (bounded, converges, finite filtrations). This repeats Steps 5-6 of [lemma-weil-pbc-hypercohomology-convergence] for a general $v$.
